system.description:
Nearly all the devotion of the blood bond, with none of its unpleasant side effects. You bind another to you through sheer force of adoration.

The subject must be in the same area and in some active social contact with you - a conversation, a shared glance, a greeting. Make a Social Challenge against the target (retest Leadership). On a success they become attached to you as if blood bound for the remainder of the scene. You may target the same subject as many times per night as you wish, but if any test beyond the first fails, they become immune to all your Presence powers for the rest of the night.
